summary: FMP Basic quota reset now models the documented fixed 15:00 EST / UTC-05:00 boundary year-round, including reservation and usage display. Full Docker backend gate and focused tests pass on the dirty candidate.

findings.sandbox: Official docs state free Sandbox access and provide stock list/history/quote/news/split/dividend data operations; source quality is best-effort and intensive market-data use should use a dedicated provider.
findings.production: Official partner API access begins at USD 2000 per month.
findings.quota: The official material reviewed does not publish Sandbox request ceilings, quota windows/reset boundaries, endpoint charges, or a native account-usage endpoint.

decision: Keep the Dinari Sandbox canary non-routable until an account-specific quota profile is evidenced; keep production disabled under the low-cost scope. Do not infer unlimited usage from free Sandbox access.

command: Reviewed Massive's current first-party free-tier rate-limit and stocks pages for the shared-pool unit and native usage visibility.
result: Confirmed 5 REST requests/minute per asset class; no documented native current-usage snapshot found.

findings.free_stocks_basic: 5 REST requests per minute per asset class; all Stocks operations share that Stocks pool
findings.current_usage: The reviewed first-party pages publish the plan limit but no native account-current-use snapshot or usage endpoint

decision: Keep the documented Stocks pool; do not admit a full live reservation until the current account-window usage baseline is safely established.

command: Reviewed Marketstack's current first-party pricing, contact, and FAQ pages for monthly allowance, billing unit, usage visibility, and ticker-list economics.
result: Confirmed Free 100 requests/month and per-ticker billing; usage is directed to dashboard and no public usage snapshot was found.

findings.free_allowance: 100 market-data requests per month; pricing/contact pages agree and are used over the contradictory FAQ sentence
findings.billing_unit: One request is charged per ticker, including multi-ticker results
findings.current_usage: Official material directs users to the account dashboard; no documented public API usage snapshot was found
findings.discovery: An exchange-wide symbol page may consume per-symbol credits; full-universe discovery remains unsafe under the free allowance without a precise endpoint/cost bound

decision: Keep Marketstack universe discovery quarantined; do not infer an exchange MIC/page cost or current monthly balance. Reuse official Nasdaq/FINRA universe sources for complete snapshots; Marketstack may still be used for bounded symbol-level market-data cases after a current monthly balance is obtained.

notes: All 19 providers were run against the same staged candidate parent/tree and each receipt reported candidate_unchanged=true. Current no-network preflight was rerun afterward against the shared private ledger: seven providers remain quarantined; zero calls in that preflight. The owner-private quota ledger contains settled cross-session reservations and provider receipts. The remaining holds are documented in the immediately following provider_live_preflight receipts.

findings.venue_ticker_route: Official v2 API reference documents GET /v2/exchanges/{mic}/tickers with MIC path parameter and pagination (limit defaults to 100, maximum 1000; offset defaults to 0). The operation returns ticker symbols and exchange metadata. Existing adapter route/parameter shape is documentation-faithful.
findings.allowance_conflict: Current FAQ says Free permits 1,000 requests/month in one answer but says Free is below 100/month in another. Do not silently resolve this conflict by raising the account configuration.
findings.multi_symbol_cost: FAQ defines a request containing five stock symbols as consuming five API requests. It does not specify whether the venue-wide ticker-directory operation is billed by page, row, or one HTTP request.
findings.account_usage: FAQ directs users to the account dashboard for up-to-date usage; no documented quota-only usage API was found in reviewed docs.
findings.pricing_risk: FAQ describes overage fees after the allowance. Keep the configured conservative 100/month cap and fail closed pending direct account-plan/usage reconciliation; do not use overage as a safety valve.

decision: Keep existing venue-discovery implementation non-routable until the account's actual plan/current usage and the specific venue-directory billing unit are established. Do not guess page cost or use conflicting FAQ allowance text to raise quota. Existing ordinary EOD operations remain subject to reconciled monthly headroom.

findings.general_api_license: Published API License states a maximum of 1,000,000 API calls in any rolling 30-day period, no rollover. It does not state in reviewed text that this is a Sandbox-specific credential entitlement or describe endpoint-specific costs/rate headers.
findings.sandbox: Official docs identify api-enterprise.sandbox.dinari.com/api/v2 as Sandbox, say Sandbox access is free, and recommend listing supported stocks as the fastest credential check without Entity/KYC/funding.
findings.market_data_character: Dinari describes stock market data as basic and best-effort and recommends a dedicated provider for intensive market-data needs.
findings.missing_contract: No authoritative public Sandbox-specific smaller/larger quota, reset boundary, per-endpoint unit cost, or native account usage counter was located in the reviewed docs.

decision: Treat 1,000,000 calls/rolling 30 days as a published general-license ceiling, not proof of this sandbox key's effective entitlement. Keep the existing one-call/day explicitly authorized Sandbox canary cap and sandbox-only isolation until safe exact-candidate evidence and actual response quota metadata/account profile establish the effective contract; do not enable general routing or production data from this evidence alone.

decision: The source contract is sufficiently documented; retry the full EODHD manifest only after the daily reset and a fresh coordinator reservation admits its 16-unit worst-case cost.

The one-call Dinari Sandbox canary was separately attempted but blocked before transport because its one-request UTC-day local allowance was already consumed. Finnhub US-stock candles (403) and FMP stable stock-list (402) were observed as expected entitlement denials within otherwise passing provider manifests; retain those capabilities as unavailable for the current keys.

command: review official Dinari API quickstart/stock-list reference and current Marketstack pricing/FAQ; inspect redacted local usage headers
result: Dinari public quota dimensions remain unpublished; Marketstack plan and discovery billing remain partially ambiguous; no provider request used

dinari.findings: Official quickstart documents Sandbox key creation and says stock listing requires no Entity/KYC/funding; Get Stocks supports paginated listing. Reviewed pages publish no numeric Sandbox request limit, quota unit, reset boundary, or usage endpoint. The successful 2026-10-11 canary had empty captured capacity headers. Retain only the one-request-per-UTC-day local canary; no full-operation quota profile can be honestly configured from available evidence.

marketstack.findings: Pricing page states 100 Free requests/month; FAQ contains conflicting 100 and 1,000 monthly figures. Billing language charges per specific stock ticker, but does not specify how /exchanges/{mic}/tickers pagination is billed. Keep the lower 100/month bound, require actual dashboard usage, and leave discovery non-routable until MIC and positive page-cost contract are supported.
